payload.title: File:Kurrartapu.png
payload.description_html:
Interpretive illustration of holotype right tarsometatarsus of Kurrartapu johnnguyeni QM F56251 in dorsal view. Scale bar is 3mm.
Reference: Nguyen JMT, Worth TH, Boles WE, Hand SJ, Archer M (2013) A new cracticid (Passeriformes: Cracticidae) from the Early Miocene of Australia. Emu 113:374-382
